newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Utilities evacuates control room.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Utilities evacuates control room.

text.p: Plant conditions were stable at the Connecticut Yankee Nuclear Power Plant after operators there evacuated control room workers, Northeast Utilities said on Thursday.
The company said a fire suppression system apparently was set off by photography equipment in the incident, but no fire took place.

"The fire suppression system discharges halon, a chemical used to extinguish fires. Because prolonged exposure to halon can result in nausea and dizziness, the control room was evacuated as a precautionary measure," the company said in a statement.
Northeast added that it had notified state, local and federal officials of the evacuation.
